integrity: Independent marked-survivor theorem based on the 2025 event-triggered renewal model and 2025 absorbing-wedge kernel. A later November 2026 direct wedge resetting preprint is explicitly compared for overlap; its unconditional tail is also independently re-derived. Finite diagnostics are not proofs, and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only pure threshold-reset Brownian wedge excursions with fixed interior restart; asymptotic weak convergence under late-survivor conditioning, no finite-time error rate, noise inference, or unbounded count-moment convergence. The probability of an eventual exit side is a retrospective future mark.
title: Marked late-survivor law for threshold-reset Brownian motion in a wedge
